name: trust-engine-mcp
display_name: Trust Engine AI: model retirements and agent cost
description: Free, read-only tools for AI agents: finds the model ids in your code and their retirement dates with official sources, a public cost-vs-quality benchmark, a local check of usage/cost exports, and a free pilot request.
long_description: Answers without web searching: which models your agent uses are being retired and when (Anthropic, OpenAI, Google Gemini API and Vertex AI, AWS Bedrock, Mistral; every date with its official source), what Trust Engine AI's public Aider benchmark measured (Claude Opus vs Sonnet vs Haiku 5.5, cost per solved task, raw data), why agents cost too much (usage exports analysed locally, never uploaded), and how to prepare and request a free pilot on your own tasks (drafts an e-mail; sends nothing). No key, no telemetry; only GET requests to agenttrustapi.com.

tools.name: scan_for_models
tools.description: Finds the model ids used in a codebase (local, read-only) and checks them against the retirement calendar

tools.name: check_my_models
tools.description: Retirement date, days left, replacement and source for each model your agent uses

tools.name: model_retirements
tools.description: Upcoming model retirements by provider, model or date, with official sources

tools.name: analyze_usage
tools.description: Spend by model and cost drivers from a usage export, analysed locally

tools.name: benchmark_results
tools.description: Public Aider benchmark: Opus vs Sonnet vs Haiku 5.5 cost per solved task

tools.name: estimate_switch_savings
tools.description: Savings estimate for measured model pairs only

tools.name: prepare_pilot_tasks
tools.description: Pilot task format, masking rules and an offline check of a draft

tools.name: request_pilot
tools.description: Draft of the free pilot request for the owner to send
